description: This file defines the ViewList class, a subclass of SugarView, responsible for preparing, processing, and displaying the list view within the SuiteCRM module. It includes methods for setting up search forms, handling user interactions, and rendering list data.

classes.name: ViewList
classes.description: A class extending SugarView, managing the preparation, processing, and rendering of list views in SuiteCRM modules.

methods.name: listViewPrepare
methods.description: Prepares metadata, search settings, display columns, and initializes the list view and search form.

methods.name: listViewProcess
methods.description: Processes the search form, sets up the list view display, and renders the list.

methods.name: prepareSearchForm
methods.description: Sets up the search form component, choosing between old and new implementations based on available files.

methods.name: processSearchForm
methods.description: Handles user input from the search form, generating search conditions and displaying appropriate search UI.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Initializes the ListViewSmarty object prior to rendering.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the list view if access is permitted.

methods.name: getSearchForm2
methods.description: Creates and returns a SearchForm object for advanced search functionality.
